sentences.en: He lost his sense of direction in the dark woods.
sentences.zh: 他在黑暗的树林里迷失了方向。

sentences.en: It began late one Sunday afternoon, deep in the woods.
sentences.zh: 这发生在一个周日下午晚些时候，深在树林里。

sentences.en: The poor girl lost her way in the dark woods.
sentences.zh: 那个可怜的女孩在黑暗的树林里迷路了。

senses.zh: 供以木材；用树木覆盖（wood 的第三人称单数）
